output.reason: The same 2.7.0 changelog says source-watcher was first added to the Flux distribution in this release [ev-3ab1e090dc9b]. So the bump to v2.0.1 [ev-2a1f31a924a0] happened during the release cycle; an environment upgrading from an earlier release had no source-watcher to update. A deterministic check also found source-watcher in neither release's manifests, and the before/after tag change was refuted. The exposure image-in-use{source-watcher} therefore flags environments that aren't exposed, uses a bare component name rather than an image repository, and the evidence gives no consequence that a correct condition could describe.
